roadmapStep: Absolute supervisor stage B1 (local design and build) after the first metadata read C01

sourceReview.method: An Opus architecture auditor and an independent Fable reviewer read the public GNU coreutils 9.4 timeout and env sources and the Node 24.21.0 process and child_process documents; root confirmed the cited source lines
sourceReview.conditions: Eleven adopted conditions, including: codes 125-127 and start-up race codes never count as a pass or as proof of a reap; READY.ppid must equal the direct child pid; a blocked or ignored TERM gives UNKNOWN; only ENOENT on the probe's /proc stat after close counts as absence

design.method: An Opus draft and an independent Fable draft, judged by an Opus auditor; root adopted the Opus draft with twelve grafts
design.shape: One behaviour package for three inert probe cases (NORMAL, TERM, KILL) with the case as configuration; fixed probe bytes; the observer may send one SIGTERM at its watchdog and never SIGKILL; the expected 124 and 137 stay scenario results inside an accepted envelope and never loosen SSH, controller or runner success checks; the 120 s window gates are unchanged

ownerDecisions: The owner accepted all ten design decisions as recommended: three separate windows in the order NORMAL, TERM, KILL, each with its own GO; the outer transport exception extended to behaviour jobs; the coreutils 9.4 residual risks accepted; UNKNOWN stops B2 and recovery needs its own GO; NOT_EXECUTED may be prepared again as a new job; no TERM or KILL rehearsal; the 15 s observer boundary kept; shrink first if the source passes 64 KiB; the same health basis and REA-paused statement per window; exec-failure and race codes give UNKNOWN

probeSources.evidence: Author suite 106 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip (real signal delivery); an independent tester re-derived every hash and the static gate refused 60 planted forbidden constructs; an Opus audit found no blocking issue; root read all three sources

behaviourRuntime.rounds: Three rounds. R1 passed the safety review but let some unexpected output give NONPASS instead of UNKNOWN and treated a read error after a successful open as absence; R2 and R3 closed those gaps
behaviourRuntime.evidence: Final author suite 743 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip, rerun by root; independent matrices with mutation controls killed every non-equivalent mutant; two Opus auditors (one replacing the paused Fable second opinion) confirmed one child only, one SIGTERM only, no SIGKILL and no file write

limits: All work was local with synthetic inputs and fake process, procfs and clock capabilities
Real signal delivery, timeout exit codes, Linux procfs and pipe behaviour can be shown only on the target in B2
A backward clock read after READY loses the diagnostic but still gives UNKNOWN
Supervisor qualification remains UNKNOWN; this record holds verdicts and hashes only
